name: wonder-repeat-v1
question: Does Muse Wonder reach an accepted recovery of the dash again, in fresh sessions, under the same rules as its first success?
success: A trial counts as a success only if a candidate passes all 13 development checks, is frozen, and then passes all 20 acceptance checks.
secondaryOutcome: Whether the accepted candidate also publishes through the JUJUMP integration.
rules: Every planned trial that starts is reported, including failures.
A started trial is never repeated, and no trial is added to improve the result.
Trials run one at a time through the authoritative cloud ledger.
The first success is the baseline. It is reported separately and does not count toward this rate.
A trial stopped by infrastructure before Wonder finished is reported with its reason, and is not counted as a success.

budget.reason: Each trial reserves $6 before it starts. At the first trial's $1.69, three trials fit and a fourth would not.

baseline.comparison: Model, task and limits match the baseline. The evaluator, check cases, agent loop and output contract are byte-identical to it. The protocol id differs because other hashed files moved or changed afterward.
